parametric-motion-path.alt: The path of a particle with x(t) = t cubed minus 6t squared plus 9t and y(t) = 4t minus t squared for t from 0 to 4. It starts at (0, 0) at t = 0, moves right and up to (4, 3) at t = 1, turns and moves left through (2, 4) at t = 2, the highest point, to (0, 3) at t = 3, then turns again and moves right and down to (4, 0) at t = 4, crossing its earlier path near (2, 1).
